description: This file defines a URL class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and key-value handling functionalities. It provides mechanisms to represent and manipulate URLs, including scheme types, components, and related utilities.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL with components such as scheme, host, port, path, query, and reference. Provides parsing, validation, and encoding/decoding functionalities.

classes.name: URL::KeyValue
classes.description: Handles key-value pairs within URL query strings, allowing existence checks, value retrieval, and type conversions.
